items.evidence: step(40, beads['A1'], wells, mix=50) dispenses 40 uL to all 96 wells and calls p300.mix(10, 50, d); the 5 min incubation comment comes before the magnet comment.
The engage-magnet comment is recorded, then remove(90, wells, waste) runs on all 96 wells, followed by two cycles of step(200, etoh) and remove(200, wells, waste).
Comments record the 5 min dry and the magnet disengage. step(50, water, wells, mix=40) adds water with 10 mixes, and a comment records the 2 min incubation and the magnet re-engage.
The loop over zip(wells, ewells) aspirates 45 uL from each sample well and dispenses it to the matching elution well, and the end_state:elution_plate check passed.
Every well gets its own pick_up_tip and drop_tip in step, remove and the final recovery loop, and the no_cross_contamination check passed.

judge.summary: The protocol performs all 96-well steps with per-well fresh tips, the correct volumes and the manual steps recorded as comments in the right order. All measured checks passed, so every rubric item passes.
